# Dhruv Arora

Personal portfolio of Dhruv Arora, a computer science and math student at UW-Madison and software engineering intern at Autodesk.

- Develops and markets Synthesis, Autodesk's open source robotics simulator for FIRST students (5K to 20K+ users during his tenure).
- Writes Rust CLI/TUI tools (astute, dirnt, monkeytype-tui) and agent-native software.
- Projects, experience, skills, and awards are on the single-page site.
- Contact: a_dhruv@outlook.com. GitHub: https://github.com/Dhruv-0-Arora

The site is an explorable 3D world: visitors ride a camera rail through districts built from his projects, or press F to drive the Dozer robot, a real Synthesis .mira (Mirabuf protobuf) file parsed live in the browser. A static page serves reduced-motion, small-screen and no-WebGL visitors.
